versos.hebraico: וְדָוִ֥יד זָקֵ֖ן וְשָׂבַ֣ע יָמִ֑ים וַיַּמְלֵ֛ךְ אֶת־שְׁלֹמֹ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: Now David was old and full of days; and he made Solomon his son king over Israel.
controles.kjv: So when David was old and full of days, he made Solomon his son king over Israel.
controles.livre: Sendo, pois, Davi já velho e farto de dias, fez a Salomão seu filho rei sobre Israel.

versos.hebraico: וַיֶּאֱסֹף֙ אֶת־כָּל־שָׂרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְהַלְוִיִּֽם׃

controles.web: He gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.
controles.kjv: And he gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.
controles.livre: E juntando a todos os principais de Israel, e a os sacerdotes e levitas,

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסָּֽפְרוּ֙ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם מִבֶּ֛ן שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וָמָ֑עְלָה וַיְהִ֨י מִסְפָּרָ֤ם לְגֻלְגְּלֹתָם֙ לִגְבָרִ֔ים שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וּשְׁמוֹנָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃

controles.web: The Levites were numbered from thirty years old and upward: and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty-eight thousand.
controles.kjv: Now the Levites were numbered from the age of thirty years and upward: and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty and eight thousand.
controles.livre: Foram contados os levitas de trinta anos acima; e foi o número deles por suas cabeças, contados um a um, trinta e oito mil.

versos.hebraico: מֵאֵ֗לֶּה לְנַצֵּ֨חַ֙ עַל־מְלֶ֣אכֶת בֵּית־יְהוָ֔ה עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָ֑לֶף וְשֹׁטְרִ֥ים וְשֹׁפְטִ֖ים שֵׁ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִֽים׃

controles.web: David said, “Of these, twenty-four thousand were to oversee the work of Yahweh’s house; six thousand were officers and judges;
controles.kjv: Of which, twenty and four thousand were to set forward the work of the house of the Lord; and six thousand were officers and judges:
controles.livre: Destes, vinte e quatro mil para dar pressa à obra da casa do SENHOR; e governadores e juízes, seis mil;

versos.hebraico: וְאַרְבַּ֥עַת אֲלָפִ֖ים שֹׁעֲרִ֑ים וְאַרְבַּ֤עַת אֲלָפִים֙ מְהַֽלְלִ֣ים לַיהוָ֔ה בַּכֵּלִ֕ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֖יתִי לְהַלֵּֽל׃

controles.web: four thousand were doorkeepers; and four thousand praised Yahweh with the instruments which I made, for giving praise.”
controles.kjv: Moreover four thousand were porters; and four thousand praised the Lord with the instruments which I made, said David, to praise therewith.
controles.livre: Ademais quatro mil porteiros; e quatro mil para louvar a o SENHOR, disse Davi, com os instrumentos que fiz para render louvores.

versos.hebraico: וַיֶּֽחָלְקֵ֥ם דָּוִ֖יד מַחְלְק֑וֹתס לִבְנֵ֣י לֵוִ֔י לְגֵרְשׁ֖וֹן קְהָ֥ת וּמְרָרִֽי׃ס

controles.web: David divided them into divisions according to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
controles.kjv: And David divided them into courses among the sons of Levi, namely, Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
controles.livre: E repartiu-os Davi em ordens conforme a os filhos de Levi, Gérson e Coate e Merari.

versos.hebraico: לַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֖י לַעְדָּ֥ן וְשִׁמְעִֽי׃ס

controles.web: Of the Gershonites: Ladan and Shimei.
controles.kjv: Of the Gershonites were, Laadan, and Shimei.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Gérson: Ladã, e Simei.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֣י לַעְדָּ֗ן הָרֹ֧אשׁ יְחִיאֵ֛ל וְזֵתָ֥ם וְיוֹאֵ֖ל שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃ס

controles.web: The sons of Ladan: Jehiel the chief, and Zetham, and Joel, three.
controles.kjv: The sons of Laadan; the chief was Jehiel, and Zetham, and Joel, three.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Ladã, três: Jeiel o primeiro, depois Zetã e Joel.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֣י שִׁמְעִ֗י שלמות וַחֲזִיאֵ֛ל וְהָרָ֖ן שְׁלֹשָׁ֑ה אֵ֛לֶּה רָאשֵׁ֥י הָאָב֖וֹת לְלַעְדָּֽן׃ס

controles.web: The sons of Shimei: Shelomoth, and Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the heads of the fathers’ households of Ladan.
controles.kjv: The sons of Shimei; Shelomith, and Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the chief of the fathers of Laadan.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Simei, três: Selomote, Haziel, e Harã. Estes foram os príncipes das famílias de Ladã.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֣י שִׁמְעִ֔י יַ֣חַת זִינָ֔א וִיע֖וּשׁ וּבְרִיעָ֑ה אֵ֥לֶּה בְנֵי־שִׁמְעִ֖י אַרְבָּעָֽה׃

controles.web: The sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zina, and Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Shimei were, Jahath, Zina, and Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Simei: Jaate, Zina, Jeus, e Berias. Estes quatro foram os filhos de Simei.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיְהִי־יַ֣חַת הָרֹ֔אשׁ וְזִיזָ֖ה הַשֵּׁנִ֑י וִיע֤וּשׁ וּבְרִיעָה֙ לֹֽא־הִרְבּ֣וּ בָנִ֔ים וַיִּֽהְיוּ֙ לְבֵ֣ית אָ֔ב לִפְקֻדָּ֖ה אֶחָֽת׃ס

controles.web: Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second: but Jeush and Beriah didn’t have many sons; therefore they became a fathers’ house in one reckoning.
controles.kjv: And Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second: but Jeush and Beriah had not many sons; therefore they were in one reckoning, according to their father’s house.
controles.livre: Jaate era o primeiro, Zina o segundo; mas Jeus e Berias não multiplicaram em filhos, por o qual foram contados por uma família.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֣י קְהָ֗ת עַמְרָ֥ם יִצְהָ֛ר חֶבְר֥וֹן וְעֻזִּיאֵ֖ל אַרְבָּעָֽה׃ס

controles.web: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.
controles.kjv: The sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Coate: Anrão, Izar, Hebrom, e Uziel, eles quatro.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֥י עַמְרָ֖ם אַהֲרֹ֣ן וּמֹשֶׁ֑ה וַיִּבָּדֵ֣ל אַהֲרֹ֡ן לְֽהַקְדִּישׁוֹ֩ קֹ֨דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֤ים הֽוּא־וּבָנָיו֙ עַד־עוֹלָ֔ם לְהַקְטִיר֩ לִפְנֵ֨י יְהוָ֧ה לְשָׁרְת֛וֹ וּלְבָרֵ֥ךְ בִּשְׁמ֖וֹ עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃

controles.web: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses; and Aaron was separated, that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons, forever, to burn incense before Yahweh, to minister to him, and to bless in his name, forever.
controles.kjv: The sons of Amram; Aaron and Moses: and Aaron was separated, that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons for ever, to burn incense before the Lord, to minister unto him, and to bless in his name for ever.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Anrão: Arão e Moisés. E Arão foi apartado para ser dedicado às mais santas coisas, ele e seus filhos para sempre, para que queimassem perfumes diante do SENHOR, e lhe ministrassem, e bendisessem em seu nome, para sempre.

versos.hebraico: וּמֹשֶׁ֖ה אִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים בָּנָ֕יו יִקָּרְא֖וּ עַל־שֵׁ֥בֶט הַלֵּוִֽי׃

controles.web: But as for Moses the man of God, his sons were named among the tribe of Levi.
controles.kjv: Now concerning Moses the man of God, his sons were named of the tribe of Levi.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Moisés, homem de Deus, foram contados na tribo de Levi.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֔ה גֵּרְשֹׁ֖ם וֶאֱלִיעֶֽזֶר׃

controles.web: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.
controles.kjv: The sons of Moses were, Gershom, and Eliezer.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Moisés foram Gérson e Eliézer.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֥י גֵרְשׁ֖וֹם שְׁבוּאֵ֥ל הָרֹֽאשׁ׃

controles.web: The sons of Gershom: Shebuel the chief.
controles.kjv: Of the sons of Gershom, Shebuel was the chief.
controles.livre: Filho de Gérson foi Sebuel o primeiro.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּֽהְי֥וּ בְנֵי־אֱלִיעֶ֖זֶר רְחַבְיָ֣ה הָרֹ֑אשׁ וְלֹא־הָיָ֤ה לֶאֱלִיעֶ֨זֶר֙ בָּנִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וּבְנֵ֥י רְחַבְיָ֖ה רָב֥וּ לְמָֽעְלָה׃

controles.web: The sons of Eliezer were: Rehabiah the chief; and Eliezer had no other sons; but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Eliezer were, Rehabiah the chief. And Eliezer had none other sons; but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.
controles.livre: E filho de Eliézer foi Reabias o primeiro. E Eliézer não teve outros filhos; mas os filhos de Reabias foram muitos.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֥י יִצְהָ֖ר שְׁלֹמִ֥ית הָרֹֽאשׁ׃ס

controles.web: The sons of Izhar: Shelomith the chief.
controles.kjv: Of the sons of Izhar; Shelomith the chief.
controles.livre: Filho de Izar foi Selomite o primeiro.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֖י חֶבְר֑וֹן יְרִיָּ֤הוּ הָרֹאשׁ֙ אֲמַרְיָ֣ה הַשֵּׁנִ֔י יַחֲזִיאֵל֙ הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י וִֽיקַמְעָ֖ם הָרְבִיעִֽי׃

controles.web: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the chief, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
controles.kjv: Of the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Hebrom: Jería o primeiro, Amarias o segundo, Jaaziel o terceiro, e Jecameão o quarto.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֖י עֻזִּיאֵ֑ל מִיכָ֣ה הָרֹ֔אשׁ וְיִשִּׁיָּ֖ה הַשֵּׁנִֽי׃ס

controles.web: The sons of Uzziel: Micah the chief, and Isshiah the second.
controles.kjv: Of the sons of Uzziel; Michah the first, and Jesiah the second.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Uziel: Mica o primeiro, e Issias o segundo.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֤י מְרָרִי֙ מַחְלִ֣י וּמוּשִׁ֔י בְּנֵ֥י מַחְלִ֖י אֶלְעָזָ֥ר וְקִֽישׁ׃

controles.web: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.
controles.kjv: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. The sons of Mahli; Eleazar, and Kish.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Merari: Mali e Musi. Os filhos de Mali: Eleazar e Quis.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֨מָת֙ אֶלְעָזָ֔ר וְלֹא־הָ֥יוּ ל֛וֹ בָּנִ֖ים כִּ֣י אִם־בָּנ֑וֹת וַיִּשָּׂא֥וּם בְּנֵי־קִ֖ישׁ אֲחֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters only: and their brothers the sons of Kish took them as wives.
controles.kjv: And Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters: and their brethren the sons of Kish took them.
controles.livre: E morreu Eleazar sem filhos, mas teve filhas; e os filhos de Quis, seus irmãos, as tomaram por mulheres.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֣י מוּשִׁ֗י מַחְלִ֥י וְעֵ֛דֶר וִירֵמ֖וֹת שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃

controles.web: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, and Eder, and Jeremoth, three.
controles.kjv: The sons of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jeremoth, three.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Musi: Mali, Éder e Jeremote, eles três.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֣לֶּה בְנֵֽי־לֵוִי֩ לְבֵ֨ית אֲבֹתֵיהֶ֜ם רָאשֵׁ֧י הָאָב֣וֹת לִפְקוּדֵיהֶ֗ם בְּמִסְפַּ֤ר שֵׁמוֹת֙ לְגֻלְגְּלֹתָ֔ם עֹשֵׂה֙ הַמְּלָאכָ֔ה לַעֲבֹדַ֖ת בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה מִבֶּ֛ן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וָמָֽעְלָה׃

controles.web: These were the sons of Levi after their fathers’ houses, even the heads of the fathers’ houses of those who were counted individually, in the number of names by their polls, who did the work for the service of Yahweh’s house, from twenty years old and upward.
controles.kjv: These were the sons of Levi after the house of their fathers; even the chief of the fathers, as they were counted by number of names by their polls, that did the work for the service of the house of the Lord, from the age of twenty years and upward.
controles.livre: Estes são os filhos de Levi nas famílias de seus pais, cabeceiras de famílias em suas linhagens, contados por seus nomes, por suas cabeças, os quais faziam obra no ministério da casa do SENHOR, de vinte anos acima.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֚י אָמַ֣ר דָּוִ֔יד הֵנִ֛יחַ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְעַמּ֑וֹ וַיִּשְׁכֹּ֥ן בִּירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם עַד־לְעוֹלָֽם׃

controles.web: For David said, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, has given rest to his people; and he dwells in Jerusalem forever.
controles.kjv: For David said, The Lord God of Israel hath given rest unto his people, that they may dwell in Jerusalem for ever:
controles.livre: Porque Davi disse: o SENHOR Deus de Israel há dado repouso a seu povo Israel, e o habitar em Jerusalém para sempre.

versos.hebraico: וְגַ֖ם לַלְוִיִּ֑ם אֵין־לָשֵׂ֧את אֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ן וְאֶת־כָּל־כֵּלָ֖יו לַעֲבֹדָתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Also the Levites will no longer need to carry the tabernacle and all its vessels for its service.”
controles.kjv: And also unto the Levites; they shall no more carry the tabernacle, nor any vessels of it for the service thereof.
controles.livre: E também os levitas não levarão mais o tabernáculo, e todos seus vasos para seu ministério.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י בְדִבְרֵ֤י דָוִיד֙ הָאַ֣חֲרֹנִ֔ים הֵ֖מָּה מִסְפַּ֣ר בְּנֵי־לֵוִ֑י מִבֶּ֛ן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וּלְמָֽעְלָה׃

controles.web: For by the last words of David the sons of Levi were numbered, from twenty years old and upward.
controles.kjv: For by the last words of David the Levites were numbered from twenty years old and above:
controles.livre: Assim que, conforme as últimas palavras de Davi, foi a contagem dos filhos de Levi de vinte anos acima.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י מַעֲמָדָ֞ם לְיַד־בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֗ן לַעֲבֹדַת֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה עַל־הַחֲצֵרוֹת֙ וְעַל־הַלְּשָׁכ֔וֹת וְעַֽל־טָהֳרַ֖ת לְכָל־קֹ֑דֶשׁ וּמַֽעֲשֵׂ֔ה עֲבֹדַ֖ת בֵּ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃

controles.web: For their office was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of Yahweh’s house, in the courts, and in the rooms, and in the purifying of all holy things, even the work of the service of God’s house;
controles.kjv: Because their office was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of the Lord, in the courts, and in the chambers, and in the purifying of all holy things, and the work of the service of the house of God;
controles.livre: E estavam sob a mão dos filhos de Arão, para ministrar na casa do SENHOR, nos átrios e nas câmaras, e na purificação de toda coisa santificada, e na demais obra do ministério da casa de Deus;

versos.hebraico: וּלְלֶ֨חֶם הַֽמַּעֲרֶ֜כֶת וּלְסֹ֤לֶת לְמִנְחָה֙ וְלִרְקִיקֵ֣י הַמַּצּ֔וֹת וְלַֽמַּחֲבַ֖ת וְלַמֻּרְבָּ֑כֶת וּלְכָל־מְשׂוּרָ֖ה וּמִדָּֽה׃

controles.web: for the show bread also, and for the fine flour for a meal offering, whether of unleavened wafers, or of that which is baked in the pan, or of that which is soaked, and for all kinds of measure and size;
controles.kjv: Both for the shewbread, and for the fine flour for meat offering, and for the unleavened cakes, and for that which is baked in the pan, and for that which is fried, and for all manner of measure and size;
controles.livre: Assim para os pães da proposição, e para a flor da farinha para o sacrifício, e para os pães sem levedura, e para as coisas postas em panelas, e para o tostado, e para toda medida e conta;

versos.hebraico: וְלַעֲמֹד֙ בַּבֹּ֣קֶר בַּבֹּ֔קֶר לְהֹד֥וֹת וּלְהַלֵּ֖ל לַיהוָ֑ה וְכֵ֖ן לָעָֽרֶב׃

controles.web: and to stand every morning to thank and praise Yahweh, and likewise in the evening;
controles.kjv: And to stand every morning to thank and praise the Lord, and likewise at even;
controles.livre: E para que assistissem cada manhã todos os dias a confessar e louvar a o SENHOR, e assim à tarde;

versos.hebraico: וּלְכֹ֨ל הַעֲל֤וֹת עֹלוֹת֙ לַיהוָ֔ה לַשַּׁבָּת֔וֹת לֶחֳדָשִׁ֖ים וְלַמֹּעֲדִ֑ים בְּמִסְפָּ֨ר כְּמִשְׁפָּ֧ט עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם תָּמִ֖יד לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: and to offer all burnt offerings to Yahweh, on the Sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the set feasts, in number according to the ordinance concerning them, continually before Yahweh;
controles.kjv: And to offer all burnt sacrifices unto the Lord in the sabbaths, in the new moons, and on the set feasts, by number, according to the order commanded unto them, continually before the Lord:
controles.livre: E para oferecer todos os holocaustos a o SENHOR os sábados, novas luas, e solenidades, por a conta e forma que tinham, continuamente diante do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וְשָׁמְר֞וּ אֶת־מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת אֹֽהֶל־מוֹעֵ֗ד וְאֵת֙ מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ וּמִשְׁמֶ֕רֶת בְּנֵ֥י אַהֲרֹ֖ן אֲחֵיהֶ֑ם לַעֲבֹדַ֖ת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃פ

controles.web: and that they should keep the duty of the Tent of Meeting, and the duty of the holy place, and the duty of the sons of Aaron their brothers, for the service of Yahweh’s house.
controles.kjv: And that they should keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the holy place, and the charge of the sons of Aaron their brethren, in the service of the house of the Lord.
controles.livre: E para que tivessem a guarda do tabernáculo do testemunho, e a guarda do santuário, e as ordens dos filhos de Arão seus irmãos, no ministério da casa do SENHOR.
